title: Dialogflow CES toolHook Request
description: Request body sent to the dialogflow verb's toolHook when a CES (model 'ces') agent requests a client-side tool. NOTE the shape differs from the CX variant, which sends {tool, action, input_parameters}: CES sends a per-call id plus display_name/args, and the id must be echoed back so the agent can correlate the result.

event.description: Discriminator; the dialogflow verb posts 'tool-call' for both CX and CES.

id.description: CES per-call identifier. The feature-server echoes this back in the tool result; without it the agent cannot correlate and the turn stalls. CX has no equivalent field.

display_name.description: Human-readable tool name, e.g. get_weather. Note snake_case: the CES REST API renders this as camelCase displayName, but the jambonz event uses snake_case.

tool.description: Tool resource path, projects/{p}/locations/{l}/apps/{a}/tools/{t}. May be absent for a toolset-sourced tool.

args.description: Parameters the agent extracted for the call, e.g. {"city":"Boston"}.
